entries.es: Nuestros frijoles refritos no llevan manteca; son aptos para vegetarianos.
entries.en: Our refried beans have no lard, so they're vegetarian-friendly.

entries.es: Nuestro arroz mexicano se hace con consomé de pollo, así que no es vegetariano ni vegano.
entries.en: Our Mexican rice is made with chicken bouillon, so it isn't vegetarian or vegan.
